subject.title: Feature request: message delete (revoke) action for WhatsApp channel

question: Should the bundled WhatsApp plugin expose bot-owned message deletion/revocation, and what public action name and safety contract should it use?
rationale: The code path is clear, but destructive WhatsApp mutation needs maintainer intent for naming, own-message constraints, expiry behavior, group keys, and proof expectations before automation should create or replace implementation work.

options.title: Sponsor constrained WhatsApp delete
options.body: Keep this issue open and review the linked PR or equivalent patch that implements bot-owned delete/revoke with strict target authorization, fromMe handling, group participant rules, and real behavior proof.

options.title: Defer destructive mutation
options.body: Leave the request open but decline implementation until live WhatsApp behavior and failure modes are better understood.

options.title: Reject channel revoke
options.body: Close the request if maintainers decide agents should not programmatically revoke WhatsApp messages because silent or ambiguous failure is too risky.

recommendation.title: Sponsor constrained WhatsApp delete
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and review the linked PR or equivalent patch that implements bot-owned delete/revoke with strict target authorization, fromMe handling, group participant rules, and real behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has prior review context on this issue and recent WhatsApp action/docs history, while the final choice is a maintainer policy boundary rather than a narrow code repair.
